_comment: Single source for every national dental-cost fact shown on Australia.md pages. scripts/seo-postprocess.mjs renders the 'Dental costs in Australia' block from this file and scripts/seo-validate.mjs (check 9) fails if a page disagrees with it. Never type these figures into a template or page. Re-verify each January: the CDBS cap is indexed on 1 January.
verified_by: claudecowork (read from the official pages listed in each `sources` entry)

cdbs.name: Child Dental Benefits Schedule (CDBS)
cdbs.eligibility: Children aged 0–17 for at least one day of the calendar year who are eligible for Medicare and who, or whose parent, carer or guardian, gets an eligible Services Australia payment at least once that year.
cdbs.bulk_billing: Some dentists bulk bill CDBS services, and then there is nothing to pay or claim. When booking, say you want to use CDBS and ask what each service will cost.

sources.title: Services Australia — Child Dental Benefits Schedule

ada_items.note: Item numbers from the Australian Dental Association's Australian Schedule of Dental Services and Glossary. They are not Medicare item numbers: CDBS claims for these services use Dental Benefits Schedule items with an 88 prefix.

items.service: Intraoral periapical or bitewing radiograph (X-ray), per exposure
